'''March 2001 Utah tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Utah in March 2001. [[Jason Ayre]] won it. It is known from Casey Barson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1998">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-01-smeg-vs-mothra-battle-royaled1998/ smeg-vs-mothra-battle-royale], DeckTech (Casey "Smeg" Barson, 1 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-01-smeg-vs-mothra-battle-royaled1998/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' March 2001
* '''Site:''' Utah
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Jason Ayre]]
